description:
We are seeking experienced Java Developers to join our team of experienced IT professionals for our clients.
 Candidates - who are legally authorized to work in USA for any employer without sponsorship and have at least 3-7 years of experience working in a corporate setting. We have positions across various locations with our client in locations across TX, NY, NJ, CA, AZ, OH, PA, FL, GA, SC, NC, etc. NO THIRD PARTIES.

 


 Min. Bachelor's Degree
 Min. 3 years of experience with Java and related technologies such as Spring, Hibernate.
 Additional skills are a huge plus - such as Hadoop/Big Data, AWS, Python, Kafka, Cassandra, etc.
 Excellent communication skills - verbal and written.
 If you are bilingual, please mention on your resume. We have some clients seeking bilingual candidates.


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
